# safentia.co.uk - marketing pages are crawlable. The console and auth
# surfaces are excluded from search via noindex meta in their document heads,
# NOT via Disallow here: a disallowed URL cannot be crawled, so its noindex
# would never be read and the bare URL could still surface in results.
User-agent: *
Allow: /

Sitemap: https://safentia.co.uk/sitemap.xml
